items.text: Ostranauts is an interesting and unique game that is bogged down by unintuitive game design, and disastrous technical issues. Much of the game is opaque and must be learned through videos and wiki pages. I tried Ostranauts out up until the refund time limit to see if I could put aside its flaws, but even with these external resources, all three of my attempts of even beginning to enter the gameplay loop ended in complete failure, and I felt as though I had wasted my time. The character creator is unique, but, again, very opaque. You pretty much have to know what you're doing in order to have the money, skills, and ship to make enough profit to pay off your first few shift fees, but the creator is RNG based, meaning you can't just try a "beginner's build" from the internet. In my 3-ish hours of playtime, the game crashed 4 times with no discernible similarities or triggers. I understand Ostranauts is early access, but it feels like it came out premature, and needs some love and care to become playable.
items.text_zh: 《Ostranauts》是一款有趣且独特的游戏，但被不直观的游戏设计和灾难性的技术问题所拖累。游戏的大部分内容都不透明，必须通过视频和wiki页面来学习。我试玩《Ostranauts》一直到退款时限，想看看自己能否放下它的缺陷，但即使有这些外部资源，我三次尝试哪怕只是开始进入游戏循环，都以彻底失败告终，我感觉自己浪费了时间。角色创建器很独特，但同样非常不透明。你几乎必须知道自己在做什么，才能拥有足够的钱、技能和飞船来赚取足够的利润，以支付你最初几次轮班费用，但创建器是基于随机数生成的，这意味着你不能直接照搬网上的“新手build”。在我大约3小时的游玩时间里，游戏崩溃了4次，没有可辨别的相似之处或触发因素。我理解《Ostranauts》是抢先体验版，但感觉它推出得过早，需要一些关爱和呵护才能变得可玩。
